lines.x: S&P Global Ratings upgraded Uzbekistan's sovereign credit rating to BB+ from BB with a stable outlook.
President Shavkat Mirziyoyev invited Turkish businesses to invest in toll roads, logistics hubs, and New Tashkent construction as Uzbekistan targets $300 billion GDP by 2030.
Gold exports from Uzbekistan fell 79% according to report data from ING.
Bilateral trade turnover between Kazakhstan and Uzbekistan grew 28.6 percent year-on-year to $4.3 billion through September 2026, while Uzbekistan's trade with China reached $17.5 billion.
